name: Maxis Berhad
overview: 今年 Maxis 的主要业务动态是旗下 Maxis Broadband 拟以最高 8300 万令吉向 MBNS 收购宽带业务资产，属于宽带业务的扩张动作。其余公告多为股息、股东大会、委员会人事变动及关联交易授权等常规事项，未披露其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约信息。
overview_en: The main business development at Maxis this year was the proposed acquisition of broadband business assets from MBNS by its wholly-owned subsidiary Maxis Broadband for a cash consideration of up to RM83 million, an expansion move in the broadband business. Other announcements were mainly routine matters such as dividends, general meetings, committee changes and related party transaction mandates, with no other expansion, reduction or contract information disclosed for other business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及宽带业务资产收购及常规公司事务。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly covered the broadband business assets acquisition and routine corporate matters.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Maxis 全资子公司 Maxis Broadband 与 MBNS 签订有条件买卖协议，拟以最高 8300 万令吉现金收购 MBNS 的宽带业务资产。
actions.text_en: Maxis' wholly-owned subsidiary Maxis Broadband entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with MBNS to acquire MBNS' broadband business assets for a cash consideration of up to RM83 million.
